blocks.prompt: 7 Given the function \(f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2x - 1}{x + 3}},\ x \ne -3\). Find the equation of the transformed function after applying in order, the horizontal shift 2 units to the left, horizontal compression by factor 3, vertical compression by factor 2, and vertical shift 1 unit downward.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh square root wale function par chaar transformations ka sawal hai, di gayi tarteeb mein.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2x - 1}{x + 3}}\), \(x \ne -3\).
Find kya karna hai? Chaaron ke baad aakhri function.
Rule: 2 baayen = \(x \to x + 2\); 3 se horizontal compression = \(x \to 3x\); 2 se vertical compression = \(\frac{1}{2}\) se zarb; 1 neeche = 1 minus.
Plan: fraction ke andar dono jagah (upar aur neeche) har x badalna hai, phir bahar wali tabdeeliyan.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{2x - 1}{x + 3}}\), \(x \ne -3\).
Maloom karna: chaar transformations tarteeb se lagane ke baad function.
Tareeqa: \(y = f(x + 2)\); \(y = g(3x)\); \(y = \frac{1}{2}h(x)\); phir 1 minus. Pehli do andar ki, aakhri do bahar ki tabdeeliyan hain.

Qadam 1: 2 units baayen
\[g_{1}(x) = \sqrt{\dfrac{2(x + 2) - 1}{(x + 2) + 3}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{2x + 3}{x + 5}}\]
Kyun: baayen 2 ka matlab \(h = -2\), is liye har \(x\) ki jagah \(x + 2\). Upar: \(2x + 4 - 1 = 2x + 3\); neeche: \(x + 2 + 3 = x + 5\).
Dhyan dein: sirf numerator ka \(x\) badal kar denominator bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

Qadam 2: 3 se horizontal compression
\[g_{2}(x) = g_{1}(3x)\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{2(3x) + 3}{3x + 5}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{6x + 3}{3x + 5}}\]
Kyun: \(y = g(bx)\) mein \(b = 3 > 1\) graph ko 3 guna dabata hai. Ab \(g_{1}\) ke har \(x\) ki jagah \(3x\) rakha; asal \(f\) par wapas nahin gaye.

Qadam 3: 2 se vertical compression
\[g_{3}(x) = \dfrac{1}{2}\sqrt{\dfrac{6x + 3}{3x + 5}}\]
Kyun: factor 2 se compression ka matlab \(a = \frac{1}{2}\); har output aadha. \(\frac{1}{2}\) root ke bahar aata hai kyun ke yeh \(y\) par tabdeeli hai.

Qadam 4: 1 unit neeche
\[y = \dfrac{1}{2}\sqrt{\dfrac{6x + 3}{3x + 5}} - 1\]
Kyun: neeche 1 ke liye har output mein se 1 kam kiya. Shart \(x 
e -3\) bhi badal gayi: naye denominator ke liye \(3x + 5 
e 0\), yani \(x 
e - rac{5}{3}\).

Tasdeeq:
\(f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 0\), yani \(\left(\frac{1}{2}, 0\right)\) \(f\) par hai. 2 baayen \(\to \left(-\frac{3}{2}, 0\right)\); 3 se compression \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, 0\right)\); vertical compression mein zero zero hi \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, 0\right)\); 1 neeche \(\to \left(-\frac{1}{2}, -1\right)\).
\[6\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) + 3 = 0\Rightarrow y = 0 - 1 = -1\]
Jawab bilkul is point se guzarta hai.
